title: The Ethics Engine: A Modular Pipeline for Accessible Psychometric Assessment of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Administering validated psychometric instruments (Right-Wing Authoritarianism and Left-Wing Authoritarianism scales) to LLMs while systematically varying prompt contexts using ideological personas (e.g., 'Extremely Liberal', 'Extremely Conservative').
Applying the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ) to measure the underlying moral values, preferences, and intuitions embedded within the language models.
